*   CSS url(). If not provided the normal density value is used.
 * @returns {string} The CSS image-set declaration as would be found in computed
 *   styles.
 */
const makeIconSet = (url, url2x) =>
  `image-set(${url} 1dppx, ${url2x || url} 2dppx)`;
